svg.title: Example system
svg.desc: Nodes: Shopper (person); Shop web app (client); Shop gateway (gateway); Payments API (service, degraded); Orders API (service); Orders database (database); Order events (queue); Payment provider (system, External); Fraud check (service). Edges: Shopper calls Shop web app. Shop web app calls Shop gateway. Shop gateway calls Orders API. Orders API calls Orders database. Orders API sends messages to Order events. Order events (order-placed) sends messages to Payments API. Payments API calls Payment provider. Payments API calls Fraud check across regions.
